CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_merchant_featured_slots()
 RETURNS SETOF merchant_featured_slots
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
    SELECT * FROM merchant_featured_slots ORDER BY created_at DESC;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_merchant_featured_slots(p_admin_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF merchant_featured_slots
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.meshwar_is_admin(p_admin_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT *
    FROM public.merchant_featured_slots
    ORDER BY created_at DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_toggle_merchant_featured_slot(p_id uuid, p_is_active boolean)
 RETURNS merchant_featured_slots
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_result merchant_featured_slots;
BEGIN
    UPDATE merchant_featured_slots
    SET is_active = p_is_active
    WHERE id = p_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_result;
    RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_upsert_merchant_featured_slot(p_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_merchant_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_slot_type character varying DEFAULT 'hero_banner'::character varying, p_banner_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_store_logo text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_store_name character varying DEFAULT ''::character varying, p_item_ids uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[], p_start_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_end_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT (now() + '30 days'::interval), p_is_active boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS merchant_featured_slots
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_result merchant_featured_slots;
BEGIN
    IF p_id IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO merchant_featured_slots (
            merchant_id, slot_type, banner_url, store_logo, store_name, item_ids, start_date, end_date, is_active
        ) VALUES (
            p_merchant_id, p_slot_type, p_banner_url, p_store_logo, p_store_name, COALESCE(p_item_ids, '{}'), p_start_date, p_end_date, COALESCE(p_is_active, true)
        )
        RETURNING * INTO v_result;
    ELSE
        UPDATE merchant_featured_slots SET
            merchant_id = p_merchant_id,
            slot_type = p_slot_type,
            banner_url = p_banner_url,
            store_logo = p_store_logo,
            store_name = p_store_name,
            item_ids = COALESCE(p_item_ids, '{}'),
            start_date = p_start_date,
            end_date = p_end_date,
            is_active = COALESCE(p_is_active, true)
        WHERE id = p_id
        RETURNING * INTO v_result;
    END IF;
    RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_upsert_merchant_featured_slot(p_admin_id uuid, p_id uuid, p_merchant_id uuid, p_slot_type character varying, p_banner_url text, p_store_logo text, p_store_name character varying, p_item_ids uuid[], p_start_date timestamp with time zone, p_end_date timestamp with time zone, p_is_active boolean)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_id uuid;
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.meshwar_is_admin(p_admin_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized';
    END IF;

    IF p_end_date <= p_start_date THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'end_date must be after start_date';
    END IF;

    IF p_slot_type NOT IN (
        'hero_banner',
        'featured_grid',
        'sponsored_product'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid slot_type';
    END IF;

    IF p_id IS NULL THEN

        INSERT INTO public.merchant_featured_slots (
            merchant_id,
            slot_type,
            banner_url,
            store_logo,
            store_name,
            item_ids,
            start_date,
            end_date,
            is_active
        )
        VALUES (
            p_merchant_id,
            p_slot_type,
            NULLIF(TRIM(p_banner_url), ''),
            NULLIF(TRIM(p_store_logo), ''),
            TRIM(p_store_name),
            COALESCE(p_item_ids, '{}'::uuid[]),
            p_start_date,
            p_end_date,
            COALESCE(p_is_active, true)
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_id;

    ELSE

        UPDATE public.merchant_featured_slots
        SET
            merchant_id = p_merchant_id,
            slot_type = p_slot_type,
            banner_url = NULLIF(TRIM(p_banner_url), ''),
            store_logo = NULLIF(TRIM(p_store_logo), ''),
            store_name = TRIM(p_store_name),
            item_ids = COALESCE(p_item_ids, '{}'::uuid[]),
            start_date = p_start_date,
            end_date = p_end_date,
            is_active = COALESCE(p_is_active, true)
        WHERE id = p_id
        RETURNING id INTO v_id;

        IF v_id IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'campaign not found';
        END IF;

    END IF;

    RETURN v_id;
END;
$function$

signature: admin_upsert_merchant_featured_slot_v2(uuid,uuid,uuid,character varying,text,text,character varying,uuid[],timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,boolean)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_upsert_merchant_featured_slot_v2(p_admin_id uuid, p_id uuid, p_store_id uuid, p_slot_type character varying, p_banner_url text, p_store_logo text, p_store_name character varying, p_item_ids uuid[], p_start_date timestamp with time zone, p_end_date timestamp with time zone, p_is_active boolean)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if p_admin_id is null or not public.meshwar_is_admin(p_admin_id) then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  if p_store_id is null then
    raise exception 'store_id is required';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.local_stores s
    where s.id=p_store_id
      and coalesce(s.is_active,true)=true
  ) then
    raise exception 'store not found or inactive';
  end if;

  if p_end_date<=p_start_date then
    raise exception 'end_date must be after start_date';
  end if;

  if p_slot_type not in ('hero_banner','featured_grid','sponsored_product') then
    raise exception 'invalid slot_type';
  end if;

  if p_slot_type='sponsored_product'
     and coalesce(array_length(p_item_ids,1),0)=0 then
    raise exception 'sponsored_product requires at least one item_id';
  end if;

  if p_id is null then
    insert into public.merchant_featured_slots(
      store_id,
      merchant_id,
      slot_type,
      banner_url,
      store_logo,
      store_name,
      item_ids,
      start_date,
      end_date,
      is_active
    )
    values (
      p_store_id,
      null,
      p_slot_type,
      nullif(trim(p_banner_url),''),
      nullif(trim(p_store_logo),''),
      trim(p_store_name),
      coalesce(p_item_ids,'{}'::uuid[]),
      p_start_date,
      p_end_date,
      coalesce(p_is_active,true)
    )
    returning id into v_id;
  else
    update public.merchant_featured_slots
    set
      store_id=p_store_id,
      merchant_id=null,
      slot_type=p_slot_type,
      banner_url=nullif(trim(p_banner_url),''),
      store_logo=nullif(trim(p_store_logo),''),
      store_name=trim(p_store_name),
      item_ids=coalesce(p_item_ids,'{}'::uuid[]),
      start_date=p_start_date,
      end_date=p_end_date,
      is_active=coalesce(p_is_active,true)
    where id=p_id
    returning id into v_id;

    if v_id is null then
      raise exception 'campaign not found';
    end if;
  end if;

  return v_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.meshwar_is_admin(p_admin_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.employees e
    WHERE e.id = p_admin_id
      AND lower(coalesce(e.role, '')) IN ('admin', 'أدمن', 'ادمن')
      AND coalesce(e.is_active, true) = true
  );
$function$
